title: spring.rocketmq
description: Two buckets: spring.rocketmq.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.rocketmq.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.rocketmq.

default.description: Family-wide values, each overridable by an instance.

driver.description: Names the Driver bean that assembles every instance's transport unless an instance names its own. Empty injects the single Driver bean by type; naming a missing bean fails startup.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

instance-name.description: Distinguishes client instances on one host; empty = SDK-derived unique name

access-key.description: ACL access key; must be set together with secret-key

secret-key.description: ACL secret key that pairs with access-key

retry.description: Producer internal retries before a synchronous send fails

fail-fast.description: Probe the first name server address with a TCP dial at startup
